slice: P4 provider-neutral skill manifest, exact projection and installer report digests

focused_gate.command: env -u AGENT_COMMONS_STATE_ROOT -u AGENT_COMMONS_STATE_BASE -u AGENT_COMMONS_SESSION_ID PYTHONPATH=. uv run --locked python -m pytest -q tests/runtime/test_skill_projection.py tests/runtime/test_launch_plan.py tests/runtime/test_provider_adapters.py tests/integrations/test_installer.py tests/services/test_manager.py::test_initialize_reports_safe_exact_skill_projection_digests

assertions: One packaged neutral manifest owns the projection version, bounded skill identities, exact skill files and provider installation roots for Codex, Claude and Grok.
Runtime projected bytes, source digest, projection digest and installer digest are deterministic and bind the immutable launched invocation fingerprint without appearing in safe launch metadata.
InstallationReport and CommonsManager.initialize expose only provider, skill identities and SHA-256 digests; skill text, prompts, credentials and provider output remain absent.
Missing, changed, symlinked, duplicate, unsupported and oversized projection inputs fail closed before provider initialization, authentication, context binding, child creation or attempt reservation.
Installer publication remains preflighted, atomic and rollback-safe; no canonical event vocabulary, second ledger or provider-output authority was introduced.
